name: 바다악어
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW aquarium game asset, not the reference character. Match the REFERENCE illustration's friendly CARTOON visual language: chunky rounded simplified silhouette, strong clean dark brown outlines, bold appealing shapes, expressive oversized glossy eyes if the animal has eyes, warm layered hand-painted cel shading and broad clean highlights. Cute stylized mobile-game character, NOT scientific drawing, realistic rendering, fine anatomical filaments or washed-out watercolor. No otter traits or otter accessories. Subject: A cute stylized SALTWATER CROCODILE swimming horizontally, sage green armored back with darker scales, cream belly, long narrow toothy snout with friendly closed smile, four tucked short legs, strong curled tail. Recognizable crocodile, no clothes. Side profile facing LEFT throughout. Maintain cute cartoon foundation.  OUTPUT a square 2x2 ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET: four equal square cells edge-to-edge, exactly ONE same character in each cell. Use thumbnail reference as exact character identity, same size and position relative to each cell. Four subtle tail and fin swimming phases. Each creature occupies central 68% of its cell with generous padding, no body turning or translation. Grid must have no visible lines. True transparent background, no ground, scenery, bubbles, cast shadow, words, watermarks, grid, labels.
padding_fix_prompt: Edit this 2x2 animation sheet ONLY to fix frame padding. Preserve the exact same ornate cartoon animal identity, colors, face, beautiful details and all four animation poses. Make EACH animal HALF its current size, including ALL fins, tail, beads and tentacles. Keep four equal square cells. Centers exactly at 25%,25%;75%,25%;25%,75%;75%,75%. Each full animal bounding box must fit in 27% of TOTAL canvas width and height (=54% of a cell). Vast transparent padding all around EACH animal. Central vertical band x=42% to58% and central horizontal band y=42% to58% must be COMPLETELY EMPTY transparent. At least 10% of outer canvas borders blank transparent. Four SMALL complete animals with broad empty gutters, no grid lines, no text, no bubbles or shadows. Actual alpha transparency. Do NOT zoom in to fill the canvas. Animation must be sliceable at exact midlines with no cut fins, tails or rays.
